crossRefs.note: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
At their presence the peoples are in anguish. All faces have grown pale.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of…
The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how they are esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of…
So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them…
She said to them, “Don’t call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me.
When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they…
Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of…
My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer.
There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my…
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

translations.web: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like a stick.
translations.bsb: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
translations.kjv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
translations.asv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: Their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
